csv_row.author: Agilkannan
csv_row.description: God-level internet research and data synthesis for any topic. Use when the user wants to research, compare, analyze, or find the best options for anything: business ideas, products (phones, laptops, gadgets), services (credit cards, banks, insurance), travel (hotels, flights, destinations), market trends, industry data, competitor analysis, pricing comparisons, consumer reviews, emerging opportunities, or any general-purpose research task. Triggers on: 'research', 'find the best', 'compare', 'what's the best', 'top 10', 'under X price', 'market data', 'industry trends', 'alternatives to', 'reviews of', or any request requiring internet research and data gathering.
csv_row.name: market-researcher
